name: Fictional supercar - V12 Goblin
author: Olli Teittinen (ollitei)
licence: CC BY 4.0 (Sketchfab, verified on the API 2026-10-10; commercial use allowed)
attribution: "Fictional supercar - V12 Goblin" by Olli Teittinen (ollitei), https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/fictional-supercar-v12-goblin-0a20e49ad5774d778567cb5c3f345786, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Modified: decimated, re-materialed and rebranded.
why: Best overall: Staff Pick with 685 likes and 31k downloads. The author's own 2012 design, shown on seriouswheels.com as his concept. Realistic paint, glass and detailed rims and brakes. 87k triangles is already inside budget, so no decimation is needed. Hand-made in 3ds Max, no AI. Clean CC BY 4.0.
risks: No interior; the glass is tinted, so it suits a chase camera only. Unknown whether the wheels are separate meshes. Uses spec-gloss materials, so check the glTF conversion. Swap the fictional emblems on the wheel centres, nose and sides for your own brand. Scale not verified. Older textures may need touch-up.

name: Generic Sport Coupé Car
author: MMC Works (mmcworks)
licence: CC BY 4.0 (Sketchfab, verified on the API 2026-10-10; commercial use allowed)
attribution: "Generic Sport Coupé Car" by MMC Works (mmcworks), https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/generic-sport-coupe-car-820a13c4831c41959ce75e6c2014e882, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Modified: re-materialed and rebranded.
why: Fills the GT/sports coupe slot with a realistic, GTA-style front-engine GT. 114k triangles, inside budget. Metalness PBR with 19 materials. Simple interior, brake discs and calipers (separate wheels likely). The author is an established hand-modeller (2020 on), and he confirms the 'Generic' series is fictional. No badges.
risks: Low-to-moderate resemblance to the Jaguar XK (X150) and the Aston Vantage/DB line, though it matches no single car. Grainy paint texture; replace it with a MeshPhysicalMaterial clearcoat. Basic interior. The rear was not seen. Wheel separation not confirmed.

name: Muscle Car Concept
author: ViktorKom
licence: CC BY 4.0 (Sketchfab, verified on the API 2026-10-10; commercial use allowed)
attribution: "Muscle Car Concept" by ViktorKom, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/muscle-car-concept-aa5dbdc7d492478ababfd4d385b8339f, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Modified: parts removed, textures resized, logos replaced.
why: The best-prepared muscle body. Game-ready Blender/Substance asset with two 4K metalness PBR sets, interior, V8 engine bay, treaded tyres and calipers. 137k triangles including all of that, so the car shell alone will be well under budget. Own front design (quad lamps in black bezels, separate centre grille). Made 2020, no AI.
risks: A mashup of cues from the Hakosuka GT-R, Challenger and Camaro. The author names them as inspiration, so never repeat those names in marketing. The rear and tail lights were not seen; look at them in the viewer before final approval. Hood, doors and trunk are posed open with no animation, so close them in Blender. Remove the engine bay and interior and downsize the 4K textures for the browser. Replace the 'V' wheel-cap logo. Wheel separation not confirmed.

name: FREE Concept Car 039 - public domain (CC0)
author: unityfan777 (Unity Fan YouTube channel)
licence: CC0 by the author's written dedication in the title and description (since publication in Oct 2020). The current Sketchfab label is 'Free Standard' (slug free-st), which also allows commercial use.
attribution: No attribution required (CC0). Courtesy credit: "FREE Concept Car 039" by unityfan777 (Unity Fan YouTube channel), https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-concept-car-039-public-domain-cc0-f17b9d37e0e34f15b4c2e417a98f5ed6, dedicated to the public domain (CC0) by the author.
why: The only body in the pool that reads as a prototype/Le Mans hypercar: canopy cockpit, raised separate front fenders, split splitter. Cleanest licence on the shortlist (CC0, no credit needed). A making-of timelapse proves it was designed from scratch. Made 2020, so no AI risk. Glossy semi-realistic paint.
risks: 301k triangles is about 1.5x the 200k ceiling; decimate to 100-150k. The licence label mismatch means you should archive a screenshot or web-archive copy of the page and its CC0 description when downloading. If you ever rely on the Standard terms instead, do not offer the GLB as a standalone download. Tyre sidewall lettering is unreadable and may be a real brand, so replace it. Canopy is opaque, so there is probably no interior. Rear and side not seen. Shape is slightly blobby, amateur-concept level. Wheel separation and scale unknown.

name: Ariel_350-V2
author: orcha (gandoplyas)
licence: CC BY 4.0 (Sketchfab, verified on the API 2026-10-10; commercial use allowed)
attribution: "Ariel_350-V2" by orcha (gandoplyas), https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/ariel-350-v2-7a9a44bcf152405792424408bb573482, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Modified: decimated, re-materialed and renamed.
carClass: touring / rally coupe (2-door liftback with rally kit); also the stand-in for the hot hatch slot
why: Covers touring/rally with verified stats. It is a rally version of the author's own fictional hatch: roll cage, bucket seats with harnesses, splitter, canards, rally wing, opening doors, hood and trunk. Its original front design matches no production car. The author's hand-made 8-model series has sibling variants that swap wheels and suspension, which points to separate wheels. Published 2026, no AI signs. Chosen over the Byakko GTR because its triangle count is known and it has no third-party trademark textures.
risks: 279k triangles is over budget; strip the cage and interior or decimate. Materials only, no textures, so tyre and decal detail must be authored. Leans stylised (the siblings are tagged 'cartoony'). 'Ariel' is a real UK carmaker, so rename it in-game. Wheel hierarchy and scale not verified.

name: F1 Car Concept
author: Hexalore
licence: CC-BY (BlendSwap licence field; version not stated, probably 3.0). BlendSwap's terms make it irrevocable and allow commercial use.
attribution: "F1 Car Concept" by Hexalore, https://blendswap.com/blend/28411, licensed under CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Modified: decimated, re-materialed, repainted and renamed.
carClass: formula / open-wheel (futuristic, partly enclosed wheels, closed canopy)
why: PROVISIONAL. It is the only formula-class body that passed verification, so it holds the slot until a better one turns up. It is an original design (enclosed-wheel fenders, fighter canopy), not a copy of any real chassis or livery. Separate wheels with brake discs. Made 2021, no AI.
risks: Triangle count unknown; the 82.5 MB .blend suggests far over 200k, so check it in Blender after applying modifiers. Drop it if it can't get to about 150k cleanly. Only medium quality: wobbly reflections on the engine cover and simple primitive mirrors and suspension. Simple Eevee shaders, so PBR must be rebuilt. The title uses the trademarks 'F1' / 'Formula 1', so rename it. Repaint the Ferrari-leaning red livery with #8 and the Pirelli-like yellow tyre band. Not a realistic modern F1 shape. Needs a free BlendSwap account to download.
